decks.notes: The main objective of this deck is to use a combination of cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up a game-winning combo. By using cards like Leyline of the Void and Opposition Agent to control the opponent's resources, as well as utilizing Helm of Obedience to combo with Leyline of the Void and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, the deck aims to create a powerful win condition. The addition of powerful creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief adds to the disruption strategy, with support from cards like Dark Ritual and Chrome Mox to accelerate the combo.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your own resources. By using cards like Wasteland, Mox Diamond, and Crop Rotation, you can effectively mana deny your opponent while ramping up your own resources. Cards like Thespian's Stage, Dark Depths, and Sejiri Steppe allow you to create powerful threats while maintaining control of the board. Additional disruption comes from cards like Pithing Needle and Sphere of Resistance, ensuring that your opponent struggles to execute their game plan while you steadily build up your own advantage.

This UWx Control deck focuses on using powerful planeswalkers like Narset and Teferi, along with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Day's Undoing provides card advantage, while cards like Blood Moon and Dress Down offer additional disruption options. Overall, the deck aims to control the game, answer threats, and eventually win through card advantage and powerful planeswalker abilities.

This deck focuses on assembling the Doomsday combo as quickly and efficiently as possible. It includes cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate a lot of mana quickly, along with spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to dig for the key pieces needed to win the game. The deck also includes disruption like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo or disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to use Doomsday to stack the library in such a way that Thassa's Oracle can win the game on the spot.

This deck focuses on using Lands to control the game, utilizing cards like Wasteland, Ghost Quarter, and Sphere of Resistance to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to assemble the Dark Depths/Thespian's Stage combo to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token, while also utilizing cards like Life from the Loam and Crucible of Worlds to recycle lands and maintain control of the battlefield. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a Companion provides additional utility and synergy with the deck's Land-focused strategy.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Wasteland. The deck also features a strong tempo game with cards like Delver of Secrets and Daze, as well as card advantage generators like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the board and finish off the opponent quickly with its efficient and versatile creatures and burn spells, creating a fast and aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence with efficient and aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Wasteland while maintaining card advantage through spells like Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble. By applying pressure early on and maintaining control of the game, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Wasteland while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Serra Avenger. It utilizes synergy between creatures and equipment to maximize damage output and control the board. Cards like Karakas and Flickerwisp provide additional utility and disruption, allowing the deck to maintain tempo and outmaneuver opponents. The overall strategy is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and steadily chip away at their life total to secure a victory.

The key concept of this deck is to efficiently and quickly reanimate powerful creatures, such as Worldgorger Dragon and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, using spells like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Dance of the Dead. The deck also includes disruption and card advantage elements with cards like Cabal Therapy, Thoughtseize, and Echo of Eons. To enable fast mana and acceleration, Lotus Petal, Chrome Mox, and Dark Ritual are included. The deck also features the use of The One Ring and Agadeem's Awakening as additional sources of value and potential game-winning plays. The land base supports the deck's strategy with cards like Ancient Tomb, Underground Sea, and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth.

The main strategy of this deck is to use Aether Vial to cheat out creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and disruptive creatures like Meddling Mage. Teferi, Time Raveler helps to control the board while cards like Baleful Strix and Gilded Drake provide value. The deck also has a focus on blinking creatures with cards like Soulherder and Venser, Shaper Savant to generate additional value. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide a powerful late-game advantage with its blink effect.

The main concept of this control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan using counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing card advantage and card selection through cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck aims to control the board state and out-value the opponent by generating incremental card advantage with cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also has a land denial aspect with cards like Wasteland and Life from the Loam, allowing the player to disrupt their opponent's mana base.

The deck revolves around quickly assembling the Dark Depths combo, which involves merging Thespian's Stage with Dark Depths to create the 20/20 token Marit Lage. The deck includes cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Knight of the Reliquary to tutor for the combo pieces and protect them. In addition, the deck runs utility lands like Karakas and Bojuka Bog to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The main goal is to efficiently put together the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a massive flying threat.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's resources with cards like Wasteland and Daze, while also deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent's life total. The deck utilizes card draw and manipulation with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistent draws and maintain tempo. The inclusion of cards like Force of Will provides protection against opposing threats. Overall, this Grixis Aggro deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

The focus of this Merfolk aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of powerful creatures. By using cards like Aether Vial and Cavern of Souls to cheat out Merfolk creatures, combined with disruptive cards like Force of Will and Wasteland to control the game, this deck aims to establish early board presence and maintain tempo. With lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident boosting the power of the Merfolk tribe, along with evasive threats like True-Name Nemesis, this deck can quickly close out games before the opponent can mount a defense.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through countering spells, disrupting their mana base, and stifling key abilities. It aims to quickly get large threats onto the battlefield, such as Phyrexian Dreadnought and Murktide Regent, while using cards like Dress Down to protect them. The deck also utilizes cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Dragon's Rage Channeler for card selection and advantage. With a mix of disruption, protection, and powerful threats, the deck's strategy is to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through efficient control tactics.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to use efficient spells and creatures to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck relies on cheap removal like Lightning Bolt and Thoughtseize, alongside disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect its threats. Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early creatures that can grow in power, while Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower offer bigger threats later in the game. The deck also includes cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to ensure consistency in drawing the right cards.
